claims: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, D.C., is underway through April 12.
As of March 21, 2026, the cherry blossom trees are progressing rapidly.
Peak bloom is expected between March 29 and April 1, 2026.
The peak bloom forecast for 2026 is March 29 to April 1, 2026.
The highest concentration of trees is around the Tidal Basin near the Jefferson, FDR, and Martin Luther King, Jr. Memorials.
The Smithsonian station (Blue/Orange/Silver lines) is a 10–15 minute walk from the Tidal Basin.
Peak bloom occurs when 70% of the Yoshino trees are open.
Peak bloom typically lasts for several days depending on weather conditions.
